name: skills-cookbook
description: Ready-to-paste example prompts that teach efficient use of the hub's skills across fourteen tracks: project understanding, feedback loops, product, marketing, design/frontend, Karpathy method, Vercel/React, engineering quality, APIs/CLIs, mobile release, data/backend, knowledge/Notion, typed decisions, and meta-harness — plus a complete A-to-Z catalog index. Ships combination recipes and an anti-pattern matrix. Use when the user asks for example prompts, how to use or combine a skill, or how to navigate the catalog with less cognitive load.
